notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin needs the object pronoun; Hebrew leaves the land implicit

notes.subject: שאה / משאה
notes.rationale: near-identical roots שואה/משאה (devastation/desolation) form a sound-pair, lost in Tok Pisin

notes.subject: דשא
notes.rationale: tender grass/sprout — rendered 'nupela gras', young grass

translation: Bihain em i fulimapim ⟨em⟩ long taim bilong bagarapim na ples i no gat wanpela man, na mekim ol nupela gras i kamap long ples ol i save pulum ⟨טל⟩ olgeta olgeta?
